description: The mutation campaign for P-022 step 7a checkpoint 4 (first-divergence reduction over the lowered and MOS layers). Separate from cp1/cp2/cp3 on purpose — each checkpoint's evidence stays frozen at what it measured. Every mutation edits a PRODUCTION surface — ownlang/repro.py or rust/crates/own-shadow/src/ — never a test. Five layers run for every mutation (discipline 3: no fail-fast), including the crate's unit tests. M00 is the harness-honesty control.

control.description: harness-honesty control: no mutation at all, which must report zero failing layers

mutations.description: the reference widens the reduction scope to the verdict layer
mutations.rule: reduction: comparing final diagnostics is #260's ACCEPTANCE, blocked by #259 — the scope is a contract, not a parameter

mutations.description: the reference reports the whole step instead of the minimal difference inside it
mutations.rule: reduction: the difference must be MINIMAL — the field, not the step body
mutations.pattern:
\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ if\ key\ in\ left\ and\ key\ in\ right:\
\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ return\ _minimal_difference\(left\[key\],\ right\[key\],\ f"\{path\}\.\{key\}"\)
mutations.replacement:
if key in left and key in right:
                    return path, left, right

mutations.description: the reference stops noticing a step only one engine addresses
mutations.rule: reduction: left-only / right-only are two of the four content classes
mutations.replacement: if False and sid not in right_steps:
expected_catchers: python::<non-zero exit with no reported failure>

mutations.description: the reference stops noticing an ordering-only difference
mutations.rule: reduction: on a layer whose order is declared significant, the sequence IS the difference

mutations.description: the reference compares two engines' refusal TEXTS, manufacturing a divergence out of message vocabulary
mutations.rule: reduction: when both engines refused, compare THAT they refused, never how they phrased it

mutations.description: the reference reports the LAST divergence instead of the first
mutations.rule: reduction: the reducer names the FIRST divergence in pipeline order

mutations.description: the reference stops distinguishing a key-ORDER difference from agreement
mutations.rule: reduction: object key order is significant — the surfaces fix field order byte-exactly
mutations.pattern:
\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ return\ \(list\(left\)\ ==\ list\(right\)\
\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ and\ all\(_same\(left\[k\],\ right\[k\]\)\ for\ k\ in\ left\)\)
mutations.replacement:
return (set(left) == set(right)
                and all(_same(left[k], right[k]) for k in left))

mutations.description: the reference carries the MOS document in `dump_summaries`' insertion order rather than its surface's
mutations.rule: capture: each layer document is carried in the key order its OWN surface fixes

mutations.description: the port widens the reduction scope to the verdict layer
mutations.rule: reduction: the scope is a contract, not a parameter

mutations.description: the port compares two engines' refusal texts instead of the fact that both refused
mutations.rule: reduction: a refusal's text is each engine's own

mutations.description: the port reports the last divergence instead of the first
mutations.rule: reduction: the reducer names the FIRST divergence in pipeline order
